_comment: Castable abilities. Damage is a multiplier on the caster's resolved hit rather than its own numbers, so affixes, sigils, inscriptions and boons all flow into every spell without any spell needing to know they exist. A spell decides shape and cost; core/damage.gd decides how much.

spells.name: Emberbolt
spells.description: The first thing anyone learns. Cheap, quick, unremarkable.
